source:
Driving qualities that help you decide your goals. You start with one - you can develop another two.

Increase your Passions with [[Experiences]], and they'll add more pips to your [[Aspect Pool]]. Whenever you act with a Passion, it'll refresh a pip of every relevant [[Aspect]] in your Pool. To put it simply: increasing your Passions, and acting with them, helps you pass checks on skills which match the Passion.

But people change. That's called character development; trauma; disillusionment; experience.

So if your actions recently have drifted another way, you can spend your Experiences to evolve one Passion into another when you level it up. Two things to be aware of: first, evolving Passions is the only time you'll need to use Experiences of the same type - this is the one time you can't mix them. And secondly, because evolving a Passion also means levelling it,once a Passion hits maximum, you can no longer change it - that's you, for good.
translation:
驱使你决定自身目标的品格。你初始拥有一种——之后还能发展另外两种。

用[[经历]]提升心念，心念会为[[性相池]]添入更多点数。每当你以一种心念行动，池中与之相关的每个[[性相]]都会恢复一点。简言之：提升心念、依心念行事，能帮你通过与该心念匹配的技艺检定。

但人是会变的。这叫成长，叫创伤，叫幻灭，也叫经历。

所以，若你近来的行事偏向了别处，你可以在升级时花费经历，把一种心念演化成另一种。有两点须知：其一，只有演化心念才必须使用同类型经历——这是唯一不能混用的场合。其二，演化心念也意味着令其升级，所以心念一旦升满，就再也不能更改——那就是你了，终局的你。
notes: l.31 新增（心念脚注）；术语按终审（心念/经历/性相池/演化），保留 4 个链接。
